exposure: Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH) diagnosis
age at DDH detection (<1 year vs >=1 year)
DDH treatment modality (major surgery, minor surgery, nonoperative)
outcome: rate of surgical treatment for DDH
cohort: A retrospective, population-based birth cohort of 2,518,805 children born in South Korea between 2008 and 2015.
finding: The incidence of overall and early diagnosed DDH increased after the NHSPIC hip screening program, but surgical treatment rates remained stable, with surgical treatment for DDH significantly associated with short stature and delayed gross motor development.
